title: Solomon Fussell House, State Route 38, Pendleton, Madison County, IN
notes: Significance: The site is located 3 miles east of Pendleton, Indiana on State Highway 38.  Though the house presently faces north, at the time it was built in 1832 it faced south.  The road at that time ran south of the house.  Located on a farm, the house is one of the few log houses still standing in Indiana.
